**Preserve the configured relay address for a separate hbbr host.** When `ALWAYS_USE_RELAY` is enabled and both peers match the LAN mask, the new path sends `PunchHole` with `inner.local_ip` instead of the configured relay address. If hbbr runs on a separate host, this can prevent the session from reaching it. Preserve the configured relay address for that case.

The rendezvous server now excludes the same-intranet path when WebSocket is used or `ALWAYS_USE_RELAY` is enabled.
